summary: The shared loader retries once in the current document, then offers an explicit graph-refresh/reload recovery; production HTML carries emitted feature JS/CSS URLs.

schema.detail: No stored or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: No public wire change; lazy recovery consumes emitted URLs from the same production build.

downtime.detail: Takes effect in the next web build; no daemon restart.

manual.detail: No operator action. Recovery requires an explicit user click.

recovery.detail: Revert this change and rebuild the web application.
